pr_title: test_runner: run global after() hook earlier
pr_body:
This commit moves the global `after()` hook execution from the `'beforeExit'` event to the point where all tests have finished running. This gives the global `after()` a chance to clean up handles that would otherwise prevent the `'beforeExit'` event from being emitted.

Fixes: https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/49056

issue_context.title: test_runner: global after not run if handles are open
comments: I'm guessing this is because the test runner uses the `beforeExit` event, and the ref'ed handle prevents that from being emitted. We'll need to move to a different mechanism for detecting when all of the tests have run.
I guessed as much, however the above pattern is really good.
CC @giltayar we might have discussed this use-case or a similar one in Node.TLV

review_comments: That's not a bad idea. Honestly though, the CI was a pain to get passing yesterday and I would prefer not to start over for that change.
